entries.title: Germany news: Merz booed as he advocates economic reform

entries.title: UK: Keir Starmer tells Cabinet he will continue in place, as two junior ministers quit

entries.title: India: New Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay cracks down on state-run TASMAC liquor shops
entries.snippet: In his first major decision since becoming the chief minister of Tamil Nadu, Vijay has ordered 717 state-run TASMAC liquor stores near religious places and schools to shut down.

entries.title: What now for the role of high representative in Bosnia?

entries.title: EU negotiators agree new rules on vital medicines
entries.snippet: A new agreement aims to tackle the drug shortages that have plagued the bloc. Among other things, it would make it easier to use public funds to support the production of essential medicines.

entries.title: US: LA area mayor to plead guilty to acting as Chinese agent

entries.title: South Africa's Ramaphosa refuses to resign over cash scandal

entries.title: Ukrainian children held in Russia: militarized, 'reeducated'

entries.title: Slovenia, Spain and Ireland won't air Eurovision over Israel's participation

entries.title: Hantavirus: How is the outbreak being contained?

entries.title: Hantavirus: How it differs from COVID
